steps.name: Setup — Create the skill via API and add a second version ('ver_1', not a numbered case action per the AFS's Test Data)
Step 1 — Open a Skill with multiple versions (base + ver_1, 'base' implicit-default since no explicit default has been set yet)
Step 3 — Verify each version row shows a pin/set-as-default control (static for the current default, hover-revealed for the non-default row)
Step 4 — Click the set-as-default control on 'ver_1'; verify the 'Set as default?' confirmation dialog opens
Step 5 — Confirm the dialog; verify the skill_default_version PATCH returns 200
